commands.description: "close <x>" -- graceful WM_CLOSE, never a forced kill.

"focus <x>" / "switch to <x>" -- registered as the bare single-token verb (no regex/prefix marker in this codebase's command matcher -- see command_registry.CommandMatcher.match(): matching is longest-registered- phrase-first, so every existing 2+-token literal macro ("open chrome", "close tab", etc.) already outranks this 1-token fallback for free).
"open <x>" -- focuses if already running, else launches.

Cancel EVERYTHING Ava has in flight, not just a staged prompt: bumps the request generation (so a model response still being awaited is dropped and anything resolving later is Denied(stale) at the choke point), clears the pending slot, the AVA session queue, the waterfall queue and the scheduler.

on_done: optional zero-arg callback fired exactly once, however this call exits -- early return (disabled/empty/unreachable) or after the worker thread finishes (success, short-circuit, or exception).
